article.title:
Discovery of
BAY-405: An Azaindole-Based MAP4K1 Inhibitor
for the Enhancement of T-Cell Immunity against Cancer

rock2_values.selectivity_ratio_definition: ROCK2 IC50 divided by MAP4K1 IC50; ratios are not ROCK2 IC50 values and are not converted into benchmark values.
rock2_values.primary_target_panel_note: SI Table S3 reports MAP4K1 (HPK1) and other kinase IC50 values; it does not provide a ROCK2 IC50 series.
rock2_values.direct_count_scope: One explicit exact ROCK2 concentration identified in article prose; no comprehensive image-table transcription claimed. Primary disqualifier is verified luminescent readout.

rock2_assay.protocol_source: Supporting Information Experimental Methods, ROCK2 assay, PDF pp. S26-S27
rock2_assay.construct: recombinant N-terminal His6-tagged human ROCK-II residues 11-552
rock2_assay.expression: baculovirus-infected SF21 insect cells; Ni-NTA purification
rock2_assay.readout: ADP-Glo kinase assay with luciferase-based glow luminescence
rock2_assay.replicates: duplicate values across an 11-point concentration series; IC50 calculated with Genedata Screener
locators: PMC11472321.xml paragraph 6 and Table 7 footnote c

eligibility.reason: Verified ROCK2 ADP-Glo luciferase readout fails non-luciferase eligibility. Supplementary CSV reports selectivity ratios rather than direct ROCK2 IC50 measurements; no values reconstructed.

limitations: Main-text SAR tables are image graphics; the supplementary CSV contains MAP4K1 IC50 and ROCK2/MAP4K1 ratios, not a direct ROCK2 IC50 column.
A ROCK2 species/construct/readout protocol is documented, but its luminescent readout disqualifies this candidate under the non-luciferase requirement.
No prediction or model fitting performed.
